data.notes: January’s confirmed calendar was strongest in the New Year/Detty December spillover window, then shifted into showcase, live-band, and homecoming-concert programming later in the month.

events.title: Music Is My Life Concert 2026
events.summary: Free New Year’s Day concert in Tema featuring Sarkodie, Kweku Smoke, King Promise, Asakaa Boys, Mista Myles, Kimilist, Ras Kuuku, Lasmid and more. The event is presented by Mimlife Records as a major annual opener for Ghana’s concert calendar.

events.title: The Water Xperience
events.venueName: Sunset Banana Beach Resort, Lower Prampram
events.summary: New Year’s Day beach festival in Lower Prampram with performances from Yaa Pono, Tulenkey, Rashid Metal, Jay Winning, Fryday Celeb, Big Busy, Tonnah Lee and DJs including DJ Wobeti, DJ Lighter and DJ Flame. The programme also included water sports, live bands and a night beach jam.

events.title: FUEGO on the Beach – Curated by Smallgod
events.summary: Smallgod-curated late-night beach-club event at Polo Beach Club. The venue described the night as focused on Afrobeats, trap and global street sounds.

events.title: Brunch n Vibes Presents Accra
events.summary: Afrobeats edition of Brunch n Vibes in Accra, promoted as a return to BloomBar. The event ran on Friday, 2 January 2026 from 7:00 PM to 11:59 PM GMT.

events.title: One Day Only – Headie One Live
events.summary: Late-night Polo Beach Club event billed as “One Day Only – 4th January 2026,” with the page title identifying Headie One Live at Polo Beach Club. The event ran from 10:00 PM on 4 January to 4:00 AM on 5 January.

events.title: OBI’S House
events.summary: Obi’s House took over Polo Beach Club for a late-night Afrobeats party running from 10:00 PM to 4:00 AM. The listing positions it as one of the venue’s major early-January season events.

events.title: ACCRA - LIVE LIFE LARGE
events.summary: 1WAY and LTL brought the Live Life Large Africa tour to Front/Back in Osu. The DICE listing billed the event as an 18+ party with an international DJ and host lineup.

events.title: The Blackout: Amaarae Homecoming Concert
events.summary: Amaarae homecoming concert in Accra, presented with music powered by iMullar Sound System. The Chale App ticket page listed the show for 7 January 2026 from 6:20 PM to 11:00 PM.

events.title: AFROSON1C X 2026
events.summary: West Africa showcase platform and conference at Treehouse, Accra, with The Cavemen. announced as headliner. The programme combined live showcases, panels, A&R listening rooms, industry networking and a regional music-tech-arts focus.

events.title: FRA!ternity Festival 2026
events.summary: Flagship annual festival curated by Ghanaian highlife-funk band FRA!, with a 16 January workshop at the British Council and a 17 January main event at Alliance Française d’Accra. The festival centres live bands, original Ghanaian music, highlife, funk and contemporary African sounds.

events.title: Tidal Rave Fest
events.summary: AccraEvents.GH lists Tidal Rave Fest for November 14, 2026 at La Palm Royal Beach Hotel, describing it as a beach rave with music, dance, fashion, entrepreneurship, content creation, and local artistes.

data.notes: December 2026 is already showing a strong Detty December spine, but many artist lineups remain unannounced this early, so this calendar favors dated, source-confirmed festivals and flagship concerts.

events.title: United World Music & Film Festival
events.venueName: Accra International Conference Centre & Black Star Square
events.summary: A four-day music, film, culture, business and innovation festival in Accra, with published daily programming including live concert kickoffs, evening concert series, a “Night of Legends” concert and a closing concert.

events.title: ALIV FEST 2026
events.summary: An 18-night Accra carnival-style destination experience with one main stage, live music performances, DJs and peak-night Afrobeats and Amapiano programming from Thursday through Sunday.

events.title: Black Sherif Zaama Disco Concert
events.summary: AccraEvents lists Black Sherif’s Zaama Disco Concert for December 21, 2026, describing it as an immersive production with lights, visuals and performers from across West Africa.

events.title: BHIM Festival
events.summary: Stonebwoy’s BHIM Festival is listed for December 24, 2026, at Accra Sports Stadium, with a focus on Afro-Dancehall, Afrobeats, Reggae, Highlife and Dancehall traditions.

events.title: Rapperholic
events.summary: Sarkodie’s annual Rapperholic concert is listed for Christmas Day 2026 in Accra, continuing one of Ghana’s signature year-end hip-hop concert brands.

events.title: Afro-GoGo Festival
events.summary: A six-day diaspora homecoming festival in Accra with live performances, DJ sets, rooftop parties, a beach party and a Go-Go x NYE finale. The music program highlights Go-Go alongside Afrobeats, Highlife, Reggae, Jazz, R&B, Amapiano and Hip-Hop influences.

events.title: Detty Rave
events.summary: Detty Rave is confirmed for December 27, 2026, on Spintex Road, with AccraEvents describing it as a high-energy end-of-year celebration blending African music, fashion, art and culture.

events.title: AfroFuture
events.summary: AfroFuture is listed for December 28–29, 2026, at El Wak Stadium, with live performances, DJs, art, food and fashion as part of Accra’s peak Detty December window.

events.title: Promiseland Concert
events.summary: Promiseland Concert is listed for December 30, 2026, on Spintex Road; the listing confirms a music-and-culture concert format, though the 2026 supporting lineup is not yet published there.

data.notes: April 2026 in Amsterdam was anchored by Easter-weekend electronic festivals, a packed King’s Day calendar, and a few major arena and club-tour concerts.

events.title: DGTL Amsterdam 2026
events.summary: DGTL returned to the NDSM-werf for a weekend of electronic music, art and production, with listed names including Dom Dolla, CamelPhat, Jayda G, I Hate Models, Gerd Janson, Luuk van Dijk and Weval live.

events.title: SPIELRAUM Weekender
events.summary: SPIELRAUM’s Easter weekender ran from Saturday night into Monday morning at CLUB RAUM. The RA-listed lineup included Bambounou, Buttechno live, Cio D’Or, Dee Diggs, livwutang, Mama Snake, Rey Colino and Tasha.

events.title: Cosmic Gate: Open To Close Amsterdam
events.summary: Cosmic Gate played an exclusive five-hour open-to-close Amsterdam show at Melkweg OZ on Easter Sunday. The event focused on the duo’s long-running trance and progressive sound.

events.title: Ratherlost Easter Sunday
events.summary: Ratherlost’s Easter Sunday edition at Lofi ran from afternoon into the next morning. Lofi’s listing named Altinbas b2b Efdemin, Oscar Mulero, Skee Mask, Polygonia, mad miran and others.

events.title: Amsterdam Calling 2026
events.summary: Amsterdam Calling returned to Melkweg as a Eurovision-focused live event and party. The programme promised live performances by Eurovision stars plus DJ sets of Eurovision classics.

events.title: We are iT Festival 2026
events.summary: We are iT Festival 2026 took over Thuishaven with a Golden Age of House Music theme. The RA-listed lineup included Jean, ROOG, Erick E, Joost van Bellen, Lucien Foort, Remy Unger and Funkerman.

events.title: Minimal Music Festival 2026
events.summary: The ninth Minimal Music Festival presented four days of hypnotic minimal, contemporary and electronic-leaning performance. The programme included Bang on a Can All-Stars’ Terry Riley 90th Birthday Celebration, Sarathy Korwar, Bendik Giske + Sam Barker, Mohammad Reza Mortazavi, Julianna Barwick and Mary Lattimore.

events.title: ROSALÍA: LUX TOUR 2026
events.summary: ROSALÍA brought her LUX TOUR 2026 to Ziggo Dome for two Amsterdam dates on 22 and 23 April. MOJO described the show around her modern flamenco-inflected pop, reggaeton, hip-hop and R&B sound.

events.title: Krezip
events.summary: Dutch pop band Krezip played Melkweg MAX with support from Tape Toy. Melkweg listed the show as part of Krezip’s 2026 club tour through the Netherlands and Belgium.

events.title: Lofi by Speedy J
events.summary: Lofi hosted a late-night techno session headlined by Speedy J. The venue listing also named Claudio PRC b2b Isabel Soto and Megan Leber for the Club room.

events.title: FYM x Oranjebloesem Kingsday Amsterdam
events.summary: Free Your Mind and Oranjebloesem joined forces for a King’s Day event at RAI Amsterdam from 12:00 to 22:00. RA’s listing included Sara Landry, Reinier Zonneveld live, Maddix, MALUGI, Michel de Hey and Prunk among the lineup.

events.title: Kingsland Amsterdam 2026
events.summary: Kingsland Amsterdam staged its King’s Day edition at the Olympic Stadium on 27 April 2026. The official site listed the date, venue and line-up section for the city’s large-scale orange-day pop and dance celebration.

data.notes: May 2026 in Amsterdam is anchored by Liberation Day city festivals, major electronic weekender Upclose and Lentekabinet, plus arena-scale pop residencies and tours.

events.title: HVYWGHT x Sonic Boom
events.summary: London dubstep crew HVYWGHT joined forces with Sonic Boom for its 20th anniversary edition at Melkweg. The confirmed lineup included Digital Mystikz, Mia Koden, Beatrice M., Lulá Luna, Brutuzz and Krackfree Soundsystem.

events.title: Bevrijdingsfestival Het Vrije Westen
events.summary: Amsterdam’s free Liberation Day festival in Westerpark presents ten stages of live music, DJs and cultural programming. The official programme names acts including Poptrash, Kraak & Smaak, Klezmagic, Kasba, Steve Rachmad and the Golden Jazz Cats.

events.title: Het Amsterdams Verbond
events.summary: The major Amsterdam Liberation Day stadium party returns to Olympisch Stadion with multiple stage takeovers and a broad house, pop and hip-hop programme. Confirmed artists include Bokoesam, Frenna, Idaly, Benny Rodrigues, DJ Chuckie, Girls Don’t Sync and Lucky Done Gone.

events.title: RÜFÜS DU SOL - Europe '26
events.summary: RÜFÜS DU SOL brought their Europe '26 show to Ziggo Dome with SG Lewis confirmed as support. Live Nation lists the Amsterdam date for Wednesday, 6 May 2026, with an additional Amsterdam date also linked from the event page.

events.title: London Calling Festival 2026
events.summary: Paradiso’s long-running discovery festival London Calling returns for two nights of new indie and alternative acts. The confirmed lineup includes Panic Shack, overpass, Meltt, Keo, Adult DVD, The New Eves, Westside Cowboy and more.

events.title: Upclose 2026
events.summary: Awakenings’ intimate techno-focused Upclose returns to Houtrak for two days. The official timetable includes Alarico b2b Ben Klock, Collabs 3000, Planetary Assault Systems, Ben UFO b2b Four Tet, Nina Kraviz, LSD live, Freddy K b2b Marrøn and many more.

events.title: Harry Styles: Together, Together
events.summary: Harry Styles opens his Amsterdam stadium residency at Johan Cruijff ArenA, with Robyn confirmed as special guest. MOJO lists the Amsterdam run across May and early June; this entry uses the explicitly listed 16 May 2026 date as the representative May date.

events.title: Lentekabinet 2026
events.summary: Dekmantel’s Lentekabinet returns to Het Twiske for its 13th edition over Pentecost weekend. The confirmed lineup includes Honey Dijon, Hunee, DJ EZ, Job Jobse, Chris Stussy b2b Shanti Celeste, Call Super, Seth Troxler, SHERELLE, Goldie and Young Marco.

events.title: Pretty Pissed 2026
events.summary: Melkweg’s punk-leaning Pretty Pissed festival returns for a third edition across its rooms. The confirmed lineup includes Aerial Salad, C’est Qui?, Deki Alem, Hammok, Kaboutertje Putlucht, Kid Kapichi, Martial Arts, Swim School and The Meffs, followed by a Wap Shoo Wap afterparty.

events.title: FIBER Festival 2026: Fragile Forces
events.summary: FIBER’s 11th edition spans Amsterdam venues with audiovisual art, experimental electronic music, club nights, sound art concerts and talks. Confirmed music programming includes Whatever the Weather, Kara-Lis Coverdale, Batu, Piezo & upsammy, Bobby Beethoven, CORIN, KUNTARI and Abdullah Miniawy Trio.

events.title: TWICE [THIS IS FOR] WORLD TOUR IN AMSTERDAM
events.summary: K-pop group TWICE plays two consecutive Amsterdam arena shows at Ziggo Dome as part of the THIS IS FOR world tour. Ticketmaster lists confirmed performances on 30 and 31 May 2026.

data.notes: June 2026 in Amsterdam is already anchored by major outdoor electronic festivals, jazz and roots programming, and a run of large Ziggo Dome arena shows.

events.title: KAYTRANADA - EUROPE '26 TOUR
events.summary: KAYTRANADA plays Ziggo Dome on 1 June 2026 with Uncle Waffles listed on the bill. The Amsterdam date is part of his Europe '26 Tour.

events.title: Holland Festival 2026
events.summary: The 79th Holland Festival runs from 3 to 28 June 2026 with 30 productions and 104 performances across 23 venues. Composer and musician Hildur Guðnadóttir is the 2026 associate artist, with music-led projects including Chernobyl, Where To From, Nærmynd and Passing Remark.

events.title: Red Light Jazz 2026
events.summary: Red Light Jazz 2026 runs across 5, 6 and 7 June with performances throughout Amsterdam's Red Light District. The listed programme includes artists such as Mark Beebe Trio, ACHHA, Chocos and Red Light Jazz Dinner feat. DJ + New Cool Collective.

events.title: 909 Festival 2026
events.summary: 909 Festival returns to Amsterdamse Bos on 6 and 7 June 2026. Confirmed names include Adam Beyer, Anfisa Letyago, Fjaak x KiNK live, Mall Grab, Ben Böhmer live, Eric Prydz, Jeff Mills and Kevin Saunderson.

events.title: Amsterdam Open Air 2026
events.summary: Amsterdam Open Air is confirmed at Gaasperpark on 6 and 7 June 2026. The city listing describes the two-day festival as a reflection of Amsterdam nightlife, spanning house, techno, disco, hip-hop and electro.

events.title: FKA twigs: BODY HIGH TOUR
events.summary: FKA twigs brings the BODY HIGH TOUR to Ziggo Dome on 6 June 2026. Yves Tumor is listed as support on the Ticketmaster event page.

events.title: DJ Bone presents: FURTHER 6th Anniversary
events.summary: DJ Bone's FURTHER marks its 6th anniversary at RADION on 6 June 2026. The RA listing confirms DJ Bone b2b Zack Fox, Ellaweeez and residents for a 23:00-07:00 night session.

events.title: Iron Maiden - Run For Your Live World Tour 2026
events.summary: Iron Maiden plays Ziggo Dome on 10 June 2026 on the Run For Your Live World Tour 2026. Evergrey is confirmed as support.

events.title: Doja Cat - Tour Ma Vie World Tour
events.summary: Doja Cat performs at Ziggo Dome on 12 June 2026 as part of the Tour Ma Vie World Tour. Ticketmaster lists the Amsterdam concert at 20:00.

events.title: Guns N' Roses - World Tour 2026
events.summary: Guns N' Roses have two confirmed Ziggo Dome shows on 18 and 20 June 2026. Mammoth is listed on the lineup for the Amsterdam dates.

events.title: Mystic Garden: Echo's of Amsterdam
events.summary: Mystic Garden lists Echo's of Amsterdam for 20 June 2026 at Sloterpark, Amsterdam. The event is presented as its summer edition, with tickets on sale via the official site.

events.title: Amsterdam Roots Festival 2026
events.summary: Amsterdam Roots Festival is confirmed for 28 June 2026 from 13:00 to 23:00. The City of Amsterdam describes it as an event where artists and makers from around the world share cultural backgrounds through music, dance, circus and theatre.

data.notes: July 2026 is unusually stacked in Amsterdam, with stadium pop/R&B runs, Pride-linked club events, and major outdoor electronic and multicultural festivals clustered around the final two weekends.

events.title: Bruno Mars – The Romantic Tour
events.summary: Bruno Mars brings The Romantic Tour to Johan Cruijff ArenA for an Amsterdam run on July 2, 4, 5 and 7, with Anderson .Paak as DJ Pee .Wee and Victoria Monét listed as special guests.

events.title: Multigroove Festival
events.summary: Amsterdam rave institution Multigroove returns to Gaasperplas for a full-day harder-styles event, with artists including Catscan, Dano, The Darkraver, DJ Isaac, Partyraiser, Promo and Ruffneck.

events.title: Madness
events.summary: British ska-pop veterans Madness play AFAS Live on July 7, returning to the Amsterdam venue with a show built around their long-running catalogue.

events.title: JOY x FLOW Festival
events.summary: JOY and FLOW join forces at Hembrugterrein on the edge of Amsterdam/Zaanstad, with three stages and a house-led lineup including Franky Rizardo, Prunk, Sidney Charles, Benny Rodrigues b2b Dennis Quin and Luuk van Dijk b2b L.P. Rhythm.

events.title: Kwaku Summer Festival
events.summary: Kwaku Summer Festival returns to Nelson Mandela Park from July 11 to August 2, combining live music, food and cultural programming. Confirmed Friday Night Concert names on the festival site include En Vogue, Broederliefde and Kassav’.

events.title: Festival Macumba
events.summary: Festival Macumba brings Latin music to De Ven in Spaarnwoude near Amsterdam, with confirmed live and DJ acts including Elena Rose, La Cendejas, Gia Fu, Gerardo Rosales y su Salsa Legendaria and Fiesta Macumba Soundsystem.

events.title: James Taylor and His All-Star Band
events.summary: James Taylor performs at AFAS Live on July 21 with his All-Star Band, in a seated singer-songwriter concert promoted by MOJO.

events.title: Milkshake Festival 2026
events.summary: Milkshake Festival returns to Westerpark on July 25 and 26 as an open-minded dance festival rooted in electronic, house, disco, pop, techno, R&B and dancehall programming.

events.title: Dekmantel Festival 2026
events.venueName: Amsterdamse Bos, Oude Kerk, Melkweg and Paradiso
events.summary: Dekmantel’s 12th edition runs July 29 to August 2, expanding across Amsterdamse Bos and city venues with 160+ electronic acts. The announced programme includes DARKSIDE, Helena Hauff, Ricardo Villalobos, DJ Sprinkles, Skrillex and Underground Resistance.

events.title: World Pride Music Festival
events.summary: World Pride Music Festival is confirmed for July 31 and August 1 at AFAS Live, running from 22:00 to 07:00 each night as a large-scale Pride music event.

events.title: XLSIOR Mykonos – Amsterdam edition
events.summary: XLSIOR Mykonos debuts in Amsterdam on July 31 as part of WorldPride 2026 at Panama Amsterdam. The Pride Amsterdam listing names Eliad Cohen, JUNYO and Manuel Coby among the DJs for the Olympians edition.

data.notes: August 2026 is unusually dense in Amsterdam, with WorldPride spillover, major electronic festivals, classical/jazz programming, and arena pop/hip-hop shows all confirmed.

events.title: Dekmantel Festival 2026
events.venueName: Amsterdamse Bos, Melkweg, Paradiso, Oude Kerk
events.summary: Dekmantel’s 12th edition runs July 29–August 2, with 160+ electronic acts and expanded city programming. Confirmed artists include DARKSIDE, Helena Hauff, Ricardo Villalobos, Skrillex, Underground Resistance featuring Saul Williams, and Ron Trent.

events.title: World Pride Music Festival
events.summary: A two-night WorldPride music event at AFAS Live, confirmed for July 31 and August 1. The venue describes the programme as featuring global headliners, DJs, and high-production performances, with the detailed timetable still unavailable.

events.title: WorldPride UNITY Concert
events.summary: One of three large WorldPride concerts on Museumplein, confirmed by the City of Amsterdam for August 4 from 18:00 to 00:00. Artist details were not yet listed on the source page.

events.title: WorldPride Wedding Party XXL
events.summary: A WorldPride Museumplein concert event confirmed by the City of Amsterdam for August 6 from 18:00 to 00:00. The listing confirms the event and venue, but not the performer lineup.

events.title: Peaches at Club Chrome
events.summary: Peaches performs at Melkweg MAX on August 7 as part of Club Chrome, Melkweg’s WorldPride 2026 programme. The event page highlights her work as a feminist musician, producer, director, and performance artist.

events.title: Grachtenfestival 2026
events.summary: Grachtenfestival runs August 7–16 and presents young classical and jazz talent across Amsterdam. The source states that ticket sales and the programme will follow from June 19.

events.title: Loveland Festival 2026
events.summary: Loveland Festival returns to Sloterpark on August 8–9 with a major house and techno lineup. Resident Advisor lists Eric Prydz, Fatboy Slim, Ben Klock, Sven Väth, Robert Hood, Joris Voorn, Nicole Moudaber, Hot Since 82, Sasha & John Digweed, and many more.

events.title: WorldPride Closing Concert
events.summary: The closing concert for Amsterdam WorldPride’s Museumplein programme is confirmed for August 8 from 18:00 to 00:00. Artist details were not yet published on the source page.

events.title: JOJI: SOLARIS
events.summary: Joji brings the SOLARIS tour to Ziggo Dome on August 25 at 20:00. Ticketmaster lists Joji with Tommy Richman on the Amsterdam date.

events.title: A$AP Rocky - Don’t Be Dumb World Tour
events.summary: A$AP Rocky plays Ziggo Dome on August 27 at 19:30 on the Don’t Be Dumb World Tour. Ticketmaster confirms the Amsterdam date and venue.

events.title: ZeeZout Festival 2026
events.summary: ZeeZout Festival is confirmed for August 29 at Tuinen van West from 13:00 to 23:00. The lineup includes 36framez, Bad Boombox, Benwal, Carista, Dr Dubplate, Mall Grab, Naone, Surusinghe, Thelma, and more.

events.title: BINI: Signals World Tour
events.summary: Filipino girl group BINI brings the Signals World Tour to AFAS Live on August 30, with doors at 18:30 and showtime at 20:00. The venue page describes their sound as global pop with layered vocals in English and Tagalog.

data.notes: September 2026 is already anchored by major arena concerts, Concertgebouw special programs, and a packed 12 September festival weekend spanning Amsterdam urban culture and Ibiza-bred house/techno.

events.title: Stars in Concert: Nikola Meeuwsen, Emma Kok, Nicola Benedetti, Caro Emerald & Sonya Yoncheva
events.summary: A European Culture Prize concert bringing together Nikola Meeuwsen, Emma Kok, Nicola Benedetti, the Caro Emerald project, Sonya Yoncheva and the National Youth Orchestra of the Netherlands.

events.title: Kumar Sanu & Anuradha Paudwal Live in Concert
events.summary: Bollywood playback icons Kumar Sanu and Anuradha Paudwal perform a nostalgia-focused concert at AFAS Live, presented by Raga Events.

events.title: Ronnie Wood and his band
events.summary: Rolling Stones guitarist Ronnie Wood plays Paradiso with his band, marking a notable return 31 years after The Rolling Stones’ 1995 Paradiso appearances.

events.title: Melanie Martinez: HADES: THE SACRIFICE
events.summary: Melanie Martinez brings the HADES: THE SACRIFICE arena tour to Ziggo Dome, presenting her cinematic alt-pop universe in Amsterdam.

events.title: The Waterboys: The Fisherman’s Blues Revue featuring Steve Earle
events.summary: The Waterboys perform a special Fisherman’s Blues Revue at AFAS Live with Steve Earle and returning fiddler Steve Wickham.

events.title: Hiromi & Metropole Orkest
events.summary: Pianist Hiromi joins the Metropole Orkest, conducted by Miho Hazama, for a jazz-fusion and orchestral program in the Concertgebouw Main Hall.

events.title: Parels van de Stad 2026
events.summary: Amsterdam’s urban culture festival returns to Riekerhaven for two days with 150+ artists across nine stages, including Yade Lauren, Lil Kleine, Jonna Fraser, Broederliefde, Monica Geuze and Idaly.

events.title: Circoloco Amsterdam
events.summary: Circoloco brings its Ibiza underground house and techno brand back to NDSM-werf for a daytime electronic dance festival.

events.title: Fairuz Our Muse, featuring Amsterdam Sinfonietta, Nai Barghouti & Wasim Arslan
events.summary: Amsterdam Sinfonietta, Nai Barghouti and Wasim Arslan perform a Concertgebouw tribute to Fairuz, curated as a cross-cultural homage to her repertoire.

events.title: Curated by Break
events.summary: Drum & bass selector Break headlines Melkweg’s Curated by night, joined by Breakage, Kira, Nymfo, VOXI & Leks and Innate MC.

events.title: Blockhead, ProleteR, Arms and Sleepers
events.summary: Blockhead, ProleteR and Arms and Sleepers bring their autumn 2026 European tour to Bitterzoet for a night of instrumental hip-hop, downtempo and electronic grooves.

events.title: Anastacia: #NTK Tour
events.summary: Anastacia performs at AFAS Live on the #NTK Tour, celebrating the 25th anniversary of her debut album Not That Kind and her greatest hits.

data.notes: October 2026 is anchored by ADE’s 30th-anniversary week, with major electronic-music showcases already confirmed alongside arena and club concerts earlier in the month.

events.title: Loreen - THE WILDFIRE TOUR
events.summary: Loreen brings THE WILDFIRE TOUR to Paradiso’s Main Hall, with doors at 19:00 and the main programme at 20:30. The show follows her new 2026 release and highlights her Eurovision-winning pop catalogue.

events.title: Fat Freddy's Drop
events.summary: Fat Freddy’s Drop play Paradiso’s Main Hall as part of a three-night Amsterdam run. The New Zealand band’s live sound blends reggae, dub, soul, techno and jazz, including material from Based On A True Story.

events.title: Amsterdam Dance Event 2026 - 30 YEARS ADE
events.summary: Amsterdam Dance Event has confirmed its 30th-anniversary edition for October 21–25, 2026. The citywide electronic-music festival and industry conference will celebrate three decades of ADE across Amsterdam.

events.title: Jean-Michel Jarre - OXYGENE & BEYOND: A Sonic Journey Celebrating 30 Years of ADE
events.summary: Jean-Michel Jarre plays an exclusive ADE Opening Concerts show at AFAS Live, celebrating both 30 years of ADE and the 50th anniversary of Oxygène. AFAS Live lists the performance for Wednesday, October 21, 2026.

events.title: Hernan Cattaneo B2B Nick Warren 6hrs - ADE
events.summary: Hernan Cattaneo and Nick Warren play a rare six-hour back-to-back set at WestWeelde during ADE. The venue lists the event on October 21, 2026, from 20:00 to 03:00.

events.title: KI/KI - 5 HOURS ADE 2026
events.summary: KI/KI makes her Ziggo Dome debut during ADE 2026 with an exclusive five-hour headline show. MOJO lists the first Amsterdam date for Thursday, October 22, 2026 at 18:30, with a second date on October 23.

events.title: Into the Woods ADE 2026
events.summary: Into the Woods turns NDSM-werf into an electronic dance festival during ADE, combining music, art, light installations and industrial/open-air stages. NDSM lists the event from October 23 to October 25, 2026.

events.title: Dockyard Festival ADE 2026 x Mystic Garden Festival
events.summary: Dockyard Festival ADE returns to Havenpark on October 24, 2026, joining forces again with Mystic Garden Festival. The official site confirms a 13:00–23:00 open-air techno and house festival.

events.title: AMF 2026
events.summary: AMF returns to Johan Cruijff ArenA on October 24, 2026, during ADE. The confirmed lineup includes Afrojack, Amelie Lens, Armin van Buuren, ARTBAT, D-Block & S-te-Fan, David Guetta’s Monolith show, Korolova and Marlon Hoffstadt.

events.title: Speedy J presents STOOR Live - ADE 2026
events.summary: Speedy J and the STOOR crew bring their fully improvised hardware-jam format back to Paradiso for ADE. The Saturday lineup is WSNWG x STOOR Live with JakoJako, Lady Starlight, UFO95, Rødhåd and Speedy J.

events.title: The Gardens of Babylon: The Seekers of Light ADE 2026 - Sunday
events.summary: The Gardens of Babylon returns to WestWeelde during ADE with its Seekers of Light showcase trilogy. The Sunday event is confirmed for October 25, 2026, from 15:30 to 03:00 across De Unie, De Wester, De Liefde and Het Restaurant.

data.notes: May 2026 in Antwerp is unusually strong for music travelers, with arena pop and rock dates sitting alongside jazz, reggae, soulful dance, drum & bass, and underground electronic festivals.

events.title: Tame Impala: Deadbeat Tour
events.summary: Tame Impala brings the Deadbeat Tour to AFAS Dome in Antwerp, with RIP Magic listed as support. The Live Nation page confirms the Tuesday 5 May 2026 date and 18:30 doors.

events.title: Liquicity Antwerp 2026
events.summary: Liquicity returns to Trix for an eight-hour drum & bass night running 21:00–05:00. The confirmed lineup includes VIKI, Dustkey, Maduk, 1991, Fred V, Tantrum Desire, Curious Mind, Frontline, Expensive KVR, Synoxis & Friends, and Bad Habitz.

events.title: Bazart at Lotto Arena
events.summary: Belgian band Bazart plays Lotto Arena in Antwerp, with DI-RECT listed as support. Live Nation confirms the Saturday 9 May 2026 show and 18:30 doors.

events.title: The Neighbourhood: THE WOURLD TOUR
events.summary: The Neighbourhood brings THE WOURLD TOUR to AFAS Dome in Antwerp. The Live Nation listing confirms the Wednesday 13 May 2026 date and identifies The Neighbourhood as the headliner.

events.title: Conan Gray: Wishbone World Tour
events.summary: Conan Gray brings the Wishbone World Tour to AFAS Dome, with Esha Tewari confirmed as special guest. Live Nation lists the Antwerp show for Friday 15 May 2026 with 18:30 doors.

events.title: NE-YO & AKON: Nights Like This Tour 2026
events.summary: NE-YO and AKON co-headline AFAS Dome on the Nights Like This Tour 2026. Live Nation confirms the Sunday 17 May 2026 Antwerp date and 18:30 doors.

events.title: Antwerp Reggae Festival 2026
events.summary: Antwerp Reggae Festival takes place at Fort Van Merksem with two stages and doors listed from 12:00 to 01:00. The published running order includes Puppa Mighty's Super Power, Joe Yorke, Johnny Ousborne & The Homegrown Band, and an indoor afterparty with Conscious Sound.

events.title: Klub Dramatik 2026

events.title: Buleleng Bali International Rhythm Competition (BBIRC)

events.title: ODAC Cuban Salsa Fiesta 2026 Bali Edition

events.title: Nusantara International Folklore Festival – Ubud, Bali
events.summary: NIFF’s official event page confirms a non-competitive folklore gathering in Ubud where dance and music groups from around the world present cultural performances, workshops, and ceremonies.

data.notes: Confirmed October 2026 music programming is still sparse, with Savaya’s electronic bookings providing the main destination-scale anchors so far.

events.title: Zamna Bali 2026 at Savaya

events.title: Hayden James at Savaya Bali

events.title: Boat Vibes Bali Vol. 4

events.title: Shivanna Halloween Party
events.venueName: The Shivanna - Benoa Check In Point
events.summary: The Shivanna Halloween Party is confirmed for October 31, 2026, as a sunset cruise from Benoa Harbour. The ticket page lists a live DJ, fire dance, canapés, and a four-hour sailing format.

The opening programme includes BEAT performing the music of King Crimson, with further confirmed names including Biffy Clyro, Belle & Sebastian, ZZ Top and Elvis Crespo.

events.title: Molotov & Mala Rodríguez

events.title: Yandel

events.title: Output pres. Nicola Cruz

data.notes: January 2026 in Berlin is anchored by winter experimental festivals, CTM and Ultraschall, alongside Berghain’s post-New-Year club calendar and a run of large arena pop/hip-hop concerts.

events.title: CTM Festival 2026: dissonate < > resonate

events.title: Ultraschall Berlin – Festival für neue Musik 2026

events.title: Halsey: Back to Badlands

events.title: Alter Bridge – What Lies Within Tour
events.summary: Alter Bridge bring the What Lies Within Tour to Columbiahalle on 25 January 2026 with special guests Daughtry and Sevendust.

data.notes: February 2026 in Berlin was especially strong for electronic music, with CTM’s closing weekend, Strom at the Philharmonie, and heavyweight Berghain/RSO/Tresor club programming alongside major arena pop and hip-hop concerts.

events.summary: Freddy K presented FRESH at RSO.BERLIN on February 20. Resident Advisor confirmed a ROBUS-floor lineup of Alarico, Freddy K, Toobris, and ÜBERKIKZ.

data.notes: March 2026 in Berlin balanced major arena rap/pop concerts with a strong club calendar and MaerzMusik’s citywide contemporary-music programme.

events.summary: Amsterdam-born techno brand Intercell returns to Lisbon for an open-air session under Ponte 25 de Abril, with Funk Tribu, Supergloss, LAMMER, Kokeshi and Maria Callapez on the RA-listed lineup.

events.title: Conan Gray – Wishbone World Tour 26
events.summary: Conan Gray makes his first Portugal appearance at MEO Arena on the Wishbone World Tour 26, following the release of his album Wishbone.

events.title: SuncéBeat New Horizons Lisbon 2026
events.summary: SuncéBeat New Horizons returns to Costa da Caparica with house, funk, soul, disco, R&B and live/DJ programming across Irmão, Praia da Sereia afterparties and boat parties. The confirmed lineup includes Kenny Dope, Louie Vega, Chez Damier, DJ Spen, Jeremy Underground, Henrik Schwarz and more.

events.title: Excursions: Lisbon 2026
events.summary: Chicago house institution Excursions lands at Rive Rouge with Cordell Johnson, James Vincent and Godi Osegueda for a late-night Lisbon session.

events.title: Rock in Rio Lisboa 2026 – June 20: Katy Perry, Charlie Puth, Pedro Sampaio, Calema and Alok
events.summary: The opening Saturday of Rock in Rio Lisboa 2026 is led by Katy Perry and Charlie Puth, with Pedro Sampaio, Calema, Alok, Audrey Nuna, Nena, Maninho, Bebe Rexha, Napa and Sofia Camara also listed.

events.title: Rock in Rio Lisboa 2026 – June 21: Linkin Park, Cypress Hill and The Pretty Reckless
events.summary: Rock in Rio Lisboa’s June 21 bill is headed by Linkin Park, with Cypress Hill, The Pretty Reckless, Grandson, Kaiser Chiefs, Hoobastank, Sepultura, P.O.D. and Portuguese acts including Sam The Kid with Orquestra e Orelha Negra.

events.title: Adrena +++ with Vladimir Dubyshkin, slin, INLIMEN and Handerson
events.summary: Riktus and ANOITECERATENTO present an Adrena techno night at Ministerium Club, headlined by Vladimir Dubyshkin in hybrid live format with slin, INLIMEN and Handerson.

events.title: Rock in Rio Lisboa 2026 – June 27: Rod Stewart, Cyndi Lauper, Shaggy and 4 Non Blondes
events.summary: Rock in Rio Lisboa’s June 27 lineup brings classic pop and rock names including Rod Stewart, Cyndi Lauper, Shaggy, 4 Non Blondes, Xutos & Pontapés, GNR, UHF, Jafumega, Joss Stone, Belo, The Wailers and Syro.

events.title: Rhythm + Waves 2026
events.summary: Rhythm + Waves debuts on Praia da Rocha in Portimão with a rap and electronic lineup listing A Boogie Wit da Hoodie, Gunna, Chase & Status, Ken Carson, D-Block Europe, Destroy Lonely, Skream, Andy C, Sherelle and more.

events.title: Rock in Rio Lisboa 2026 – June 28: 21 Savage, Central Cee, Rema and Matuê
events.summary: The final day of Rock in Rio Lisboa 2026 is a hip-hop, Afrobeats and pop-leaning bill headed by 21 Savage, Central Cee, Rema and Matuê, with Filipe Ret, Dennis, Carlão, Irina Barros, Lola Índigo and CeeLo Green also confirmed.

data.notes: July 2026 is already anchored by major festival weekends in Portimão and greater Lisbon, with Afro Nation, NOS Alive, Ageas Cooljazz and several specialist rock, electronic and reggae events confirmed.

events.title: Afro Nation Portugal 2026
events.summary: Afro Nation Portugal returns to Portimão from 3–5 July 2026. The official site confirms the 2026 lineup schedule by day for the world-scale Afrobeats, amapiano, hip-hop and R&B beach festival.

events.title: LISB-ON #Jardim Sonoro 2026
events.summary: Resident Advisor lists LISB-ON 2026 at Jardim Keil do Amaral with programming across 3 and 4 July. Confirmed names include CamelPhat, Rødhåd b2b MARRØN, Adam Ten, Kölsch, Ben Sims, Folamour, Sven Väth, Kerri Chandler, BASHKKA and Anfisa Letyago.

events.title: EVILLIVE Warm-Up
events.summary: MEO Arena confirms the official EVILLIVE Warm-Up on 4 July 2026 at Sala Tejo. The lineup features Trivium, Cavalera performing Chaos A.D., and Portuguese extreme-metal act Okkultist.

events.title: EVILLIVE Festival 2026
events.summary: EVILLIVE Festival returns to Lisbon’s MEO Arena for a one-day edition on 5 July 2026. Confirmed artists include Marilyn Manson, Megadeth, Mastodon, Converge, The Gathering and Imminence.

events.title: Ageas Cooljazz 2026
events.summary: Ageas Cooljazz runs in Cascais from 8–31 July 2026 with a confirmed line-up across multiple nights. Officially listed highlights include Gilberto Gil, David Byrne, Loyle Carner, Jamiroquai, Diana Krall, Franz Ferdinand, Scissor Sisters and Chet Faker.

events.title: Scorpions - Coming Home 2026
events.summary: Scorpions bring the Coming Home 2026 Tour to MEO Arena in Lisbon on 8 July 2026. The venue listing confirms the date, session time and promoter for the German rock band’s Portugal stop.

events.title: NOS Alive 2026
events.summary: NOS Alive 2026 is confirmed for 9, 10 and 11 July in Algés, just outside Lisbon. Official artist pages and the festival site list major names including Twenty One Pilots, Nick Cave & The Bad Seeds, Wolf Alice, Lorde, Pixies, Teddy Swims and Florence + The Machine.

events.title: Grupo Revelação - Lisboa
events.summary: BOL lists Brazilian samba and pagode group Grupo Revelação at Monsantos Open Air in Lisbon on 19 July 2026. The listing confirms a 20:00 session and describes the show as a return to Portugal for the long-running group.

events.title: Belle & Sebastian - If You’re Feeling Sinister in Full
events.summary: BOL confirms Belle & Sebastian at Coliseu de Lisboa on 21 July 2026. The show is billed as a full performance of If You’re Feeling Sinister followed by a second set of favourites.

events.title: One Sound Unification 2026
events.summary: One Sound Unification is confirmed for 24–26 July 2026 at Tuga Natura in the Lisbon area. The official schedule lists reggae and sound-system names including The Heptones, Admiral Tibet, Earl Sixteen, Johnny Clarke, Bass Odyssey, Bodyguard and Coxsone Sound.

events.title: Alpha Blondy
events.summary: BOL confirms Alpha Blondy at Monsantos Open Air in Lisbon on 31 July 2026. The listing bills the Ivorian reggae figure for a six-and-a-half-hour open-air event with doors at 17:00 and a 20:00 session.

data.notes: August 2026 is anchored by Lisbon’s late-summer festival run, with major outdoor festivals, jazz programming, and Algarve/Portimão beach-season concerts confirmed.

events.title: Jazz em Agosto 2026
events.summary: The 42nd edition of Jazz em Agosto presents 14 concerts at Fundação Calouste Gulbenkian, including Joachim Kühn, Anna Webber: Shimmer Wince, Ches Smith: Clone Row, Chicago Underground Duo and SML. The official agenda lists concerts from 31 July through 9 August 2026.

events.title: Ye - Live in Portugal
events.summary: Ye, formerly Kanye West, is listed for a one-night Portugal concert at Estádio Algarve on 7 August 2026. The official BOL ticket page confirms the date, venue and ticketing details.

events.title: Mar Me Quer Portimão 2026
events.summary: Mar Me Quer returns to Portimão’s riverside for its 2026 edition from 12 to 14 August. The confirmed first lineup includes Maiara & Maraisa on 12 August, Veigh on 13 August and Orochi on 14 August.

events.title: O Sol da Caparica 2026
events.summary: O Sol da Caparica returns to Costa da Caparica from 13 to 16 August 2026 as a major Lusophone music festival near Lisbon. The Visit Lisboa listing describes four days across pop, hip hop, rock, electronic music and other Portuguese-language styles.

events.title: Hermanos Gutiérrez
events.summary: Hermanos Gutiérrez play Coliseu dos Recreios in Lisbon on 26 August 2026 at 21:00. The Coliseu listing describes the duo’s instrumental sound as mixing Latin guitars, western, surf music and desert influences.

events.title: MEO Kalorama 2026
events.summary: MEO Kalorama returns to Parque da Bela Vista in Lisbon from 28 to 30 August 2026. The official lineup announcement confirms Robbie Williams, Ms. Lauryn Hill with special guests, Deftones, Turnstile, Grace Jones, Interpol, Clipse, Freddie Gibbs + The Alchemist and a PANORAMA Lisboa electronic stage.

data.notes: September’s confirmed calendar is Lisbon-heavy; no Portimão flagship music events were found confirmed for September 2026 yet.

events.title: Fischer-Z
events.summary: British new wave and alternative-rock band Fischer-Z return to Portugal for a 50th-anniversary concert at Coliseu dos Recreios. The venue listing confirms the September 4 date and 21:00 start.

events.title: The Weeknd: After Hours Til Dawn Tour with Playboi Carti
events.summary: The Weeknd brings the After Hours Til Dawn stadium tour to Lisbon for two Estádio do Restelo dates, with Playboi Carti listed as support. Live Nation confirms September 6 with an alternative September 5 date.

events.title: The Living Tombstone – Multiplayer Tour
events.summary: The electronic-rock duo The Living Tombstone play LAV - Lisboa Ao Vivo on September 9 as part of the Multiplayer Tour. Songkick lists Multiplayer Tour on the bill and confirms doors at 21:00.

events.title: The Neighbourhood – The Wourld Tour
events.summary: The Neighbourhood bring THE WOURLD TOUR to MEO Arena on September 12, with Nessa Barrett listed as support. Visit Lisboa confirms doors at 18:30 and show time at 20:00.

events.title: CA7RIEL & Paco Amoroso – Free Spirits World Tour
events.summary: Argentine duo CA7RIEL & Paco Amoroso bring their Free Spirits World Tour to Lisbon’s Sala Tejo on September 13. Live Nation confirms the date, venue, and 20:00 show time.

events.title: Sigur Rós – The Orchestral Tour
events.summary: Sigur Rós perform The Orchestral Tour at Sagres Campo Pequeno on September 17, accompanied by the Lisbon Sinfonietta Orchestra and the Ricercare Choir. The venue confirms doors at 20:00 and show time at 21:00.

events.title: Gentleman – Live 2026
events.summary: German reggae artist Gentleman returns to Portugal with Gentleman – Live 2026 at LAV - Lisboa Ao Vivo on September 18. The venue listing highlights his album Mad World and confirms a 21:30 start.

events.title: Phonica – Marisa Monte & Orquestra ao Vivo
events.summary: Marisa Monte presents Phonica with her band and a 55-piece symphony orchestra at MEO Arena on September 18. The arena listing confirms the 21:00 session and the orchestral format under maestro André Bachur.

events.title: Mac DeMarco
events.summary: Mac DeMarco plays LAV - Lisboa Ao Vivo on September 20, presenting his album Guitar. The venue listing confirms doors at 20:30 and concert start at 21:00.

events.title: Fat Freddy’s Drop
events.summary: Fat Freddy’s Drop return to Lisbon for a Sagres Campo Pequeno stop on September 23, celebrating the 21st anniversary of Based On A True Story. Visit Lisboa confirms the date and venue.

events.title: Ty Segall
events.summary: Ty Segall performs at LAV - Lisboa Ao Vivo on September 23. Fever’s ticket listing confirms the Lisbon date and Sala 1 at LAV as the venue.

events.title: Placebo – 30th Anniversary Tour
events.summary: Placebo open the Portugal leg of their 30th Anniversary Tour at Sagres Campo Pequeno on September 29. The venue confirms doors at 19:00 and show time at 20:00.

data.notes: January 2026 was especially strong for London club programming, with E1, fabric, KOKO and Night Tales all running notable electronic nights alongside arena-scale pop and pop-punk concerts.

events.title: E1⁷: Blackworks invites 999999999
events.summary: Blackworks brought Italian techno duo 999999999 to E1 as part of the venue’s E1⁷ birthday programming. The lineup also listed Alja Al Saadi, Arman John, AVCI, AMMARA and Dexphase.

events.title: E1⁷: Pan-Pot All Night Long (The Grand Closing)
events.summary: Pan-Pot played an all-night-long techno set at E1 for the grand closing of the venue’s seventh-birthday celebrations. The event was promoted by E1 and Crowded London.

events.title: KOKO Electronic: Dave Lee
events.summary: KOKO Electronic hosted Z Records founder Dave Lee for a house and disco-led Friday night at KOKO. The venue billed the show as Lee’s return to the theatre with special guests TBA.

events.title: Metalheadz Residency: Grooverider, Loxy, Digital, Chinese Daughter + more
events.summary: A representative date from Metalheadz’s four-Friday January residency at Night Tales, celebrating three decades of the drum & bass label. The 9 January lineup featured Grooverider, Loxy, Digital, Chinese Daughter, Diverge and Cleveland Watkiss.

events.title: Origins x BCCO - future.666, ÜBERKIKZ, SHDW
events.summary: Origins and BCCO presented a techno-focused night at fabric with future.666, ÜBERKIKZ and SHDW. DICE listed the event for 16 January 2026 at fabric.

events.title: Sasson & Mont Rouge
events.summary: KOKO Electronic hosted Paris-born DJ and producer Sasson alongside Swiss trio Mont Rouge. The venue described the sound as deep, Afro and melodic house.

events.title: ALIVE: Lee Ann Roberts, Parfait, DJ Hyperdrive
events.summary: E1’s ALIVE series booked Lee Ann Roberts, Parfait and DJ Hyperdrive for a hard techno night. The RA listing also included Becky Stroke, Cristian Collodoro and Hortense de Beauharnais.

events.title: All Time Low: EVERYONE'S TALKING! TOUR
events.summary: All Time Low brought the EVERYONE'S TALKING! TOUR to The O2 arena. The venue listing named Mayday Parade and Taylor Acorn as special guests.

events.title: Murda Live in London
events.summary: Dutch-Turkish rapper Murda performed at indigo at The O2. The O2 listing highlighted his hits in the Netherlands and Türkiye and noted collaborations with artists including Tion Wayne, Ezhel and Mero.

events.title: Agnes
events.summary: Swedish pop artist Agnes returned to London for a KOKO show featuring hits such as “Release Me,” “Fingers Crossed” and “Here Comes The Night.” KOKO billed it as a disco-pop performance.

events.title: For All Of Us: Technimatic
events.summary: Technimatic brought the For All Of Us event to KOKO for a daytime drum & bass session. The event page described the party as a celebration of soulful, uplifting drum & bass.

events.title: Jason Derulo
events.summary: Jason Derulo’s The Last Dance UK arena tour stopped at The O2 arena. The venue listed Thera and LZ7 as special guests.

data.notes: February 2026 in London was especially strong for electronic music, with major warehouse-scale Drumsheds shows, fabric programming, KOKO club nights, and big-room concerts.

events.title: ANOTR at KOKO
events.summary: Dutch house duo ANOTR played a one-off KOKO Electronic night, with the venue billing it as an intimate return after sold-out shows.

events.title: fabric Continuum: Ellen Allien, Oscar Mulero, Adiel, X CLUB., Quest B2B Quelza, Daria Kolosova
events.summary: fabric’s first Continuum of 2026 ran as a 25-hour techno session with Ellen Allien, Oscar Mulero, Adiel, X CLUB., Quest B2B Quelza and Daria Kolosova among the bill.

events.title: Mathame All Night Long at KOKO
events.summary: Italian melodic techno duo Mathame played an all-night-long KOKO theatre session, promoted by the venue as a rare intimate UK show.

events.title: Jayda G, Bibi Seck, Helena Star at KOKO
events.summary: Jayda G returned to KOKO with Bibi Seck and Helena Star for an Electronic Nights programme focused on dancefloor-led house and electronic music.

events.title: Herrensauna 10 Years at FOLD
events.summary: Berlin collective Herrensauna celebrated 10 years at FOLD with CEM, JASSS, MCMLXXXV, SALOME, Slim Soledad, Twang and ZACKITO on the lineup.

events.title: Giolì & Assia at KOKO
events.summary: Italian duo Giolì & Assia made their KOKO theatre debut with a live/DJ-led sound blending techno, house, indie and pop elements.

events.title: Teletech XXL at DRUMSHEDS
events.summary: Teletech, The Warehouse Project and Broadwick Live brought a large-scale hard-techno showcase to DRUMSHEDS, with Azyr B2B BLK., Fantasm, Holy Priest, MarcelDune, Novah B2B Hannah Laing and many more.

events.title: anyone can dance: Eastern Margins at the Barbican
events.summary: The Barbican launched its anyone can dance late-night party series with an Eastern Margins-curated night featuring Nick Cheo, KOLLIN, Jianbo and MEYY.

events.title: DJ Marky & Friends at KOKO
events.summary: DJ Marky & Friends took over KOKO for a daytime event celebrating drum & bass, jungle and Marky’s Brazilian-rooted global club sound.

events.title: FAC51 The Haçienda at DRUMSHEDS
events.summary: FAC51 The Haçienda staged its biggest indoor show to date at DRUMSHEDS, headlined by Groove Armada, Haçienda Classical, Deep Dish, Roger Sanchez, Inner City and other house-music figures.

events.title: Eastenderz at DRUMSHEDS
events.summary: Eastenderz returned to London for its biggest showcase yet at DRUMSHEDS, with house and tech-house names led by East End Dubs, Hot Since 82, Kolter, Jamback, Laidlaw and Cristina Lazic.

events.title: Fred again.. USB002 Residency at Alexandra Palace
events.summary: Fred again.. continued his USB002 London residency at Alexandra Palace, with the official label press release listing 12, 13, 26 and 27 February 2026 London dates.

data.notes: March 2026 in London was unusually strong for arena-scale country, jazz and pop benefit concerts, alongside major electronic takeovers at Drumsheds, Roundhouse and fabric.

events.title: C2C: Country to Country 2026
events.summary: Country To Country returned to The O2 for three days, with Zach Top, Keith Urban and Brooks & Dunn listed among the main headliners. The official O2 page also confirmed additional artists including Scotty McCreery, Russell Dickerson, Drake Milligan and Alana Springsteen.

events.title: Teenage Cancer Trust at Royal Albert Hall 2026
events.summary: The 2026 Royal Albert Hall benefit concert series was curated by Robert Smith and featured Elbow, Mogwai, Manic Street Preachers, My Bloody Valentine, Garbage with Placebo, and Wolf Alice across the week. The source lists each nightly bill and date from 23 to 29 March.

events.title: Southbank Centre x Montreux Jazz Festival Residency
events.summary: The Southbank Centre and Montreux Jazz Festival residency returned for a three-day programme themed around “What is Jazz Today?”. Listed highlights included Theo Croker, Children of Zeus, Women in Jazz and corto.alto.

events.title: Trans Mission
events.summary: Trans Mission was billed by OVO Arena Wembley as a one-night solidarity concert, with Adam Lambert, Beth Ditto, Beverley Knight, Christine and the Queens, Olly Alexander, Romy, Sophie Ellis-Bextor, Sugababes, Tom Grennan and Wolf Alice among the listed performers. The venue page confirms the 11 March 2026 date.

events.title: Wu-Tang Clan: Wu-Tang Forever - The Final Chamber
events.summary: Wu-Tang Clan brought the Wu-Tang Forever: The Final Chamber tour to The O2 on Tuesday 17 March 2026, with Havoc of Mobb Deep and DJ Target listed as special guests. The O2 page confirms the 17 March date and venue.

events.title: ANTS at Drumsheds
events.summary: Ibiza party brand ANTS staged its biggest London show at Drumsheds, with B2B sets including Andrea Oliva b2b Ilario Alicante, Loco Dice b2b Green Velvet, Nic Fanciulli b2b Prunk and TSHA b2b HoneyLuv. Kaboodle lists the event for 6 March 2026 at Drumsheds.

events.title: Drumcode London at Drumsheds
events.summary: Drumcode returned to Drumsheds for a 30-year showcase featuring Adam Beyer, Bart Skils, Cassian, Chris Avantgarde, Eli Brown, Kasia, Kevin de Vries, Marco Faraone and Victor Ruiz among the listed lineup. The Drumsheds registration page confirms Saturday 7 March.

events.title: Laufey - A Matter of Time Tour
events.summary: Laufey played two O2 arena dates on the A Matter of Time Tour, with Alice Phoebe Lou listed as special guest. The official venue page confirms shows on Sunday 8 and Monday 9 March 2026.

events.title: Continuum: Craig Richards, Call Super, Nicolas Lutz, DJ Nobu, Channel One, Gabrielle Kwarteng
events.summary: fabric’s Continuum programme listed Craig Richards, Call Super, Nicolas Lutz, DJ Nobu, Channel One, Gabrielle Kwarteng, Willow, XDB and more for its 28 March edition. Resident Advisor marks the event as an RA Pick and lists techno and house as genres.

events.title: Labyrinth presents: Oliver Heldens at Roundhouse
events.summary: Labyrinth presented Oliver Heldens at Roundhouse on 6 March 2026, with BL3SS and GAWP listed as support. Resident Advisor confirms the 19:00–23:00 event time and lineup.

events.title: HOLI FEST 2026 London
events.summary: Desi Beatz and BollywoodLDN presented HOLI FEST 2026 at The Cause, billed as an outdoor colour-throwing festival celebrating South Asian music and culture. The RA listing confirms 7 March 2026 at The Cause with a music policy covering Bollywood, Desi anthems, house, dance and club classics.

data.notes: April 2026 in London was especially strong for electronic programming, with fabric, KOKO, Studio 338, Roundhouse and Southbank Centre all carrying notable club, live and festival events.

events.title: London Soundtrack Festival 2026
events.summary: The second London Soundtrack Festival ran across four days celebrating film, TV and games music. David Arnold headlined the 2026 edition, with events hosted at venues including the Barbican, Cadogan Hall and Westminster Central Hall.

events.title: Roundhouse Three Sixty Festival 2026
events.summary: Roundhouse Three Sixty returned with a broad arts-and-music programme including Kae Tempest, Amaarae, Imogen Heap, Carl Craig & Octave One, Femi Koleoso’s Good Vibes Day and Situation Dance. The festival marked the Camden venue’s 20th anniversary since reopening.

events.title: Multitudes 2026
events.summary: Southbank Centre’s orchestral-led Multitudes festival ran from 16–30 April 2026. Its centrepiece was Un-natural Harmony: Sounds of Lee Alexander McQueen, a London Contemporary Orchestra collaboration reworking music tied to McQueen’s runway legacy.

events.title: Olivia Dean: The Art of Loving Live
events.summary: Olivia Dean opened her first headline run at The O2 on 29 April 2026 as part of The Art of Loving Live tour. The O2 listing confirmed further London dates on 30 April, 1–2 May and 11–12 June.

events.title: KOKO Electronic: Joseph Capriati
events.summary: Joseph Capriati returned to KOKO for a Friday late-night electronic show with Miguelle & TONS and Vanee. The event was part of KOKO Electronic’s April programme.

events.title: All Day I Dream of London with Lee Burridge
events.summary: All Day I Dream brought its melodic house sound to Studio 338 with Lee Burridge, Satori, Pippi Ciez, Dim Kelly and Raw Main. The event ran from 2pm to 2am at the Greenwich venue.

events.title: fabric: Joris Voorn (All Night Long), ELIF, Ivory, RICHE, Nyra
events.summary: Joris Voorn played an all-night-long Room 1 set at fabric, joined across the venue by ELIF, Ivory, RICHE and Nyra. The Saturday programme ran from 23:00 to 07:00.

events.title: fabric: giegling
events.summary: Giegling took over fabric with live sets from Map.ache, Swayzak, Edward, Tobias. and Leafar Legov, plus DJ sets from Cassy, Konstantin, Eduardo de la Calle and others. The event ran overnight on 18 April.

events.title: FABRICLIVE: Sarz, VIGRO DEEP, Dave Nunes, Nicky Summers, Jordss, TMXO, Aniko + more
events.summary: FABRICLIVE hosted a multi-room programme led by Sarz & Friends, with Sarz, VIGRO DEEP, Dave Nunes and Nicky Summers in Room 1. The night also included PULSE (NL) and Jordss Presents Journeyss rooms.

events.title: Palais: Bradley Zero (All Night Long) - 4 Fridays of Rhythm Section
events.summary: Bradley Zero played an all-night-long Rhythm Section residency date at Palais in Peckham. The listing framed the April run as four Fridays of Rhythm Section, with X & Ivy in the ballroom on the 24 April edition.

events.title: Carl Craig & Octave One Live
events.summary: Detroit techno figures Carl Craig and Octave One performed live as part of Roundhouse Three Sixty, presented with Labyrinth. The event also featured a pre-show screening of Desire: The Carl Craig Story.

events.title: Labyrinth presents: Cassius Live
events.summary: Labyrinth presented Cassius Live at KOKO, with Boombass bringing the French touch project back to London. The event was listed as an early-evening electronic show on Saturday 25 April.

data.notes: May 2026 in London is anchored by the Brockwell Park festival run, Peckham’s GALA weekend, and several arena-scale pop and electronic shows at The O2.

events.title: RÜFÜS DU SOL at The O2
events.summary: RÜFÜS DU SOL headline The O2 with special guest SG Lewis on 13 May 2026. The arena show brings one of electronic music’s biggest live acts to Greenwich.

events.title: Highways Festival 2026
events.summary: Highways Festival returns to Royal Albert Hall from 15–17 May 2026. The country and Americana weekend is headlined by Jon Pardi, Carly Pearce and Emmylou Harris.

events.title: RAYE: This Tour May Contain New Music
events.summary: RAYE closes her major arena run with two May dates at The O2 on 19 and 20 May 2026. ABSOLUTELY and AMMA are listed as special guests.

events.title: GALA ’26
events.summary: GALA returns to Peckham Rye Park for a three-day edition from 22–24 May 2026. The lineup spans South London rap, bass, house and disco, with Giggs, CASisDEAD, Todd Terje, DJ Seinfeld and Seth Troxler among the listed names.

events.title: Black Coffee: Live With Orchestra
events.summary: Black Coffee brings his Live With Orchestra concept to The O2 on 22 May 2026. The show is billed as his biggest UK performance to date and combines his Afropolitan house sound with a full orchestra.

events.title: Field Day 2026
events.summary: Field Day takes over Brockwell Park on 23 May 2026. The electronic-focused bill includes Floating Points live, Honey Dijon, Andy C, Joy Orbison, KI/KI, Eliza Rose and more.

events.title: ZAYN: The Konnakol Tour
events.summary: ZAYN brings The Konnakol Tour to The O2 on 23 May 2026. The show is part of his largest solo tour to date and follows the release of his KONNAKOL album.

events.title: Cross The Tracks 2026
events.summary: Cross The Tracks returns to Brockwell Park on 24 May 2026. The jazz, soul, funk and hip-hop lineup includes Little Simz, Joy Crookes, Kokoroko, KNUCKS, WAR, Obongjayar and Fabio & Grooverider with The Outlook Orchestra.

events.title: City Splash 2026
events.summary: City Splash takes place at Brockwell Park on 25 May 2026. The Caribbean and African culture celebration lists Gyptian, Beres Hammond, Jada Kingdom, Aidonia, Elephant Man, Rampage Sound and many more.

events.title: Doja Cat: Tour Ma Vie World Tour
events.summary: Doja Cat brings the Tour Ma Vie World Tour to The O2 on 29 May 2026. The show supports her fifth studio album, Vie.

events.title: Mighty Hoopla 2026
events.summary: Mighty Hoopla returns to Brockwell Park across 30–31 May 2026. The pop and queer-culture festival lists Lily Allen, Scissor Sisters, Jessie J, Perrie, Five, JLS and Todrick Hall among its lineup.

events.title: Raindance 2026 at fabric
events.summary: Raindance returns to fabric on 30 May 2026 for a daytime rave across three rooms. The lineup includes DJ Brockie, Nicky Blackmarket, Nookie, Blapps Posse & The Freestylers, Pete Cannon and more.

data.notes: June 2026 is unusually strong in London, with citywide showcases, Southbank curation, arena pop/R&B, outdoor park concerts and a solid underground-club run all confirmed.

events.title: SXSW London 2026 Music Festival
events.summary: SXSW London’s music programme takes over Shoreditch with showcase artists including Earl Sweatshirt, Sega Bodega, Rachel Chinouriri, ODUMODUBLVCK, Tiwa Savage and Shame. The event combines live music, industry programming and cross-cultural showcases across the week.

events.title: Harry Styles’ Meltdown
events.summary: Harry Styles curates the 31st Meltdown festival at Southbank Centre, with confirmed programming including Warpaint, Shabaka & Friends, Erika de Casier, Kamasi Washington, Nilüfer Yanya, Devonté Hynes Ensemble, Yussef Dayes, Jon Hopkins and Soulwax. Styles is also listed for a Royal Festival Hall appearance during the festival.

events.title: Hampton Court Palace Festival 2026
events.summary: The palace concert series returns with confirmed 2026 headliners including David Gray, OMD, Pete Tong Ibiza Classics, The Stranglers, Nile Rodgers & CHIC, Elvis Costello & The Imposters, Sophie Ellis-Bextor and 80s Classical. It is a near-London heritage-setting music festival with nightly shows in June.

events.title: FKA twigs: BODY HIGH TOUR
events.summary: FKA twigs plays a UK-exclusive BODY HIGH TOUR show at The O2 with special guest Yves Tumor. The event is tied to her EUSEXUA Afterglow era and is billed by The O2 for Wednesday 10 June 2026.

events.title: Olivia Dean: The Art of Loving Live
events.summary: Olivia Dean brings The Art of Loving Live to The O2 for a London arena run; this entry uses the explicitly listed 11 June 2026 date. The O2 also lists a second June date on 12 June.

events.title: KAYTRANADA with Uncle Waffles
events.summary: KAYTRANADA headlines The O2 with Uncle Waffles as special guest. The O2 lists the show for Thursday 18 June 2026 as part of his upcoming tour.

events.title: Start of the Line Festival
