events.title: ROSALÍA: LUX TOUR 2026
events.summary: ROSALÍA returned to Paris for two Accor Arena dates on March 18 and 20 as part of the LUX TOUR 2026. The show supported her LUX era and positioned her as one of the month’s biggest international pop bookings.

events.title: Thundercat at Salle Pleyel
events.summary: Thundercat stopped at Salle Pleyel on Wednesday, March 18, with Andy 4000 listed as support. The show highlighted his jazz, funk, soul and R&B fusion in a seated-and-standing concert configuration.

events.title: LEGENDS: Louie Vega, Joe Claussell, DJ Deep
events.summary: Rex Club hosted a heavyweight house night on March 15 with Louie Vega, Joe Claussell and DJ Deep. The bill brought New York house lineage and Parisian deep-house heritage into one late-night club session.

events.title: Rex Club presents: Sama' Abdulhadi
events.summary: Rex Club presented Palestinian techno artist Sama' Abdulhadi on Friday, March 27. Resident Advisor listed the event as a Rex Club-promoted techno night running from 23:59 to 07:00.

data.notes: May 2026 in Paris is unusually strong for electronic music, with Boiler Room, Cercle Festival, Marvellous Island, Rex Club programming, and several arena-scale pop/R&B concerts.

events.title: Tame Impala at Accor Arena
events.summary: Tame Impala brings the Deadbeat-era European tour to Accor Arena for a single Paris arena date.

events.title: Boiler Room: Paris
events.summary: Boiler Room’s two-night Paris takeover pairs a house-focused Thursday lineup including Chris Stussy, Cassius and Sweely with a Friday techno program featuring Héctor Oaks, Helena Hauff, Trym and BIIA.

events.title: NE-YO & AKON: Nights Like This Tour 2026
events.summary: NE-YO and Akon co-headline Accor Arena on their Nights Like This Tour, billed by the venue as a nostalgia-heavy R&B and pop arena show.

events.title: Supersonic’s Block Party Festival 2026
events.summary: Supersonic’s fourth Block Party edition takes over around ten Bastille-area venues for three days, with 70 international groups listed across the daily programs.

events.title: TWICE <THIS IS FOR> World Tour in Paris
events.summary: K-pop group TWICE plays two Accor Arena dates on the Paris stop of the <THIS IS FOR> World Tour.

events.title: Festival Jazz à Saint-Germain-des-Prés
events.summary: The long-running Saint-Germain jazz festival returns across notable Left Bank venues, presenting headline concerts and emerging jazz talent.

events.title: Festival ManiFeste
events.summary: Ircam-Centre Pompidou’s ManiFeste festival focuses on contemporary creation, electronic music, multimedia and live performance across partner venues in Paris.

events.title: Cercle Festival 2026
events.venueName: Musée de l’Air et de l’Espace, Paris-Le Bourget
events.summary: Cercle Festival returns to Le Bourget for three days with a large international electronic lineup including Eric Prydz, ARTBAT, Adriatique, Kerri Chandler, Kölsch and Ben Böhmer.

events.title: Marvellous Island Festival 2026
events.summary: Marvellous Island’s 14th edition brings its open-air electronic festival format back to Torcy, with Ben Hemsley, Dennis Cruz, Korolova, Mathame, Nic Fanciulli, Reinier Zonneveld, Fatima Hajji and Ilario Alicante among the listed artists.

events.title: Skryptöm: Audrey Danza, Mana Mind, Electric Rescue
events.summary: Skryptöm returns to Rex Club after a six-year absence, with Audrey Danza, Mana Mind and Electric Rescue on the techno lineup.

events.title: Bouss at Accor Arena
events.summary: French rapper Bouss plays two Accor Arena shows after adding a second date, with the venue highlighting his mix of rap, vocals and world-influenced sounds.

events.title: ¡Amour Sauvage Festival #4
events.summary: Cabaret Sauvage hosts the fourth ¡Amour Sauvage Festival, with a techno and downtempo lineup including Etienne Jaumet, DJ Beluga92, Antoine Calvino and Remote.

data.notes: June is stacked for Paris, led by major outdoor festivals, stadium pop/electronic shows, and a few heavyweight club-night picks.

events.title: We Love Green 2026
events.summary: The official 2026 lineup lists Gorillaz, Little Simz, Feu! Chatterton, Mac DeMarco, Hayley Williams, Overmono, The xx, Charlotte de Witte, Dom Dolla, Ethel Cain and more across 5–7 June. The festival takes place at Bois de Vincennes / Plaine de la Belle Étoile.

events.title: Soft Power Festival
events.venueName: Multi-venues: Freestyle Villette, Le TLM and à la Folie
events.summary: RA reports Soft Power’s first edition running 9–14 June across Paris venues, with Dana Montana & Babu as Girls @ Work, KALIKA live, Tina Tornade, TRASHIE, Harey izé, MASCHA, Maria Kalash and Diane. The programme combines cabaret, DJ performances, discussions and workshops from the Kluster collective.

events.title: Rex Club presents: Octave One Live, STL-P, WhereIsFenix
events.summary: Resident Advisor lists this Rex Club techno night for Friday 5 June with Octave One Live, STL-P and WhereIsFenix. Rex Club is the promoter on the listing.

events.title: Doja Cat — Tour Ma Vie World Tour
events.summary: Accor Arena confirms Doja Cat on 9 June 2026 as part of the Tour Ma Vie World Tour. Naomi Sharon is listed as the opening act.

events.title: Kalash
events.summary: Paris La Défense Arena confirms Kalash for a one-off XXL concert on 12 June 2026. The venue frames the show as a milestone after his previous La Cigale, L’Olympia and Accor Arena dates.

events.title: David Guetta — The Ultimate Monolith Show
events.summary: Stade de France confirms David Guetta’s special 13 June concert, billed as The Ultimate Monolith Show. Black Coffee is listed as the opening act on the official event page.

events.title: KAYTRANADA
events.summary: Accor Arena confirms KAYTRANADA for 16 June 2026. The listing notes the date follows his co-headlining tour with JUSTICE and forms part of a European and UK arena run.

events.title: Cypress Hill & Special Guest DJ Premier
events.summary: Accor Arena confirms Cypress Hill for Thursday 18 June 2026, describing it as the group’s biggest Paris concert to date. DJ Premier is listed as the special guest.

events.title: Bruno Mars — The Romantic Tour
events.summary: Stade de France confirms Bruno Mars for Saturday 20 June 2026 as part of The Romantic Tour, with Paris dates also listed for 18 and 21 June. Anderson .Paak appears on all dates under his DJ Pee .Wee alias, with select support including Victoria Monét, RAYE and Leon Thomas.

events.title: Foo Fighters — Take Cover Tour 2026
events.summary: Paris La Défense Arena confirms Foo Fighters on Friday 19 June 2026 for the Take Cover Tour 2026. The venue bills it as the band’s only French date on the tour.

events.title: Iron Maiden — Run For Your Lives Tour
events.summary: Paris La Défense Arena confirms Iron Maiden for Monday 22 June 2026 on the Run For Your Lives tour. Evergrey is listed as support.

events.title: Solidays 2026
events.summary: Paris.fr confirms Solidays at Hippodrome de Longchamp from 26–28 June 2026. The 2026 names listed include Orelsan, GIMS, Major Lazer, Zara Larsson, Bigflo & Oli, Guy2Bezbar, Helena, Mosimann, Suzane and La Mano1.9.

data.notes: July 2026 is unusually stadium-heavy in Paris, with major Latin, pop, K-pop, rock and electronic festival dates clustered in the first three weekends.

events.title: Guns N’ Roses – World Tour 2026
events.summary: Guns N’ Roses are confirmed for two Accor Arena shows on July 1 and July 3, 2026. Mammoth is listed as opening act on the venue page.

events.title: System Of A Down with Queens Of The Stone Age and Acid Bath
events.summary: System Of A Down are confirmed at Stade de France on July 2 and July 4, 2026. The Stade de France listing names Queens Of The Stone Age and Acid Bath as special guests.

events.title: Yardland 2026
events.summary: Yardland is confirmed for July 3–5, 2026, with a day-by-day urban music lineup including Niska, Jorja Smith, Skepta and Rema. The festival focuses on rap, R&B, Afro and dancehall-adjacent contemporary popular culture.

events.title: Paris New York Heritage Festival 2026
events.summary: Paris New York Heritage Festival is confirmed for July 3–5, 2026 at Parc André Citroën. The official site describes the event as an EcoVillage built around jazz, soul and funk, with concerts and DJ sets; the full artist program is still marked as forthcoming.

events.title: Bad Bunny – DeBÍ TiRAR MáS FOToS World Tour
events.summary: Bad Bunny is confirmed for July 4 and 5, 2026 at Paris La Défense Arena, billed as his first performance in France. CHUWI is listed as the opening act.

events.title: Def Leppard with special guest Extreme
events.summary: Def Leppard are confirmed at Accor Arena on July 8, 2026, with Extreme as special guest. The venue frames it as Def Leppard’s first Paris show in nearly 30 years.

events.title: The Weeknd 2026 at Stade de France
events.summary: The Weeknd is confirmed for four Stade de France concerts on July 8, 10, 11 and 12, 2026. The official Stade de France ticket office lists the July 8 date as the fourth and final added show.

events.title: Vulfpeck 2026
events.summary: Vulfpeck are confirmed for a single Accor Arena show on July 9, 2026. The venue bills the Los Angeles group’s Paris return as a funk-heavy arena date.

events.title: Peacock Society 2026
events.summary: Peacock Society is confirmed as an open-air electronic festival on July 10–11, 2026 at Hippodrome Paris-Vincennes. The official lineup page lists artists including Four Tet, Floating Points, Boys Noize b2b SALOME, Channel Tres b2b Busy P, Benga & Flowdan, Palms Trax and Mia Koden.

events.title: B7KLAN J-Rock Festival
events.summary: B7KLAN J-Rock Festival is confirmed for July 11 and 12, 2026 at Arena Grand Paris, celebrating 20 years of Japanese activities. The organizer-side lineup includes Versailles, MUCC, LM.C and Kizu on July 11, with Moi Dix Mois, D’espairsRay, An Cafe, Jiluka, Azavana and Imperial Age on July 12.

events.title: BTS 2026 at Stade de France
events.summary: BTS are confirmed for two Stade de France concerts on July 17 and 18, 2026. The official Stade de France ticket office bills them as two special dates for the K-pop group’s return.

events.title: Romeo Santos & Prince Royce – Mejor Tarde Que Nunca Tour
events.summary: Romeo Santos and Prince Royce are confirmed for a joint Accor Arena concert on July 19, 2026. The venue describes it as their first time joining forces in Europe on the Mejor Tarde Que Nunca tour.

data.notes: September 2026 in Paris is already anchored by major arena pop/hip-hop dates, a Céline Dion arena residency, and strong electronic-festival programming around Chatou/La Villette.

events.title: Joji — SOLARIS TOUR
events.summary: Joji brings the SOLARIS TOUR to adidas arena for a France-exclusive Paris date, with Tommy Richman listed for the European dates. The venue page confirms a 1 September 2026 concert.

events.title: Jazz à la Villette: Selah Sue and The Gallands
events.summary: Part of Jazz à la Villette, this 4 September concert presents Selah Sue with The Gallands at Grande Halle de La Villette. The Philharmonie page lists the festival dates and confirms the performance time at 8:00 pm.

events.title: Madame Loyal X Elektric Park
events.summary: Madame Loyal and Elektric Park join forces for a two-day open-air rave/funfair event in Chatou, about 20 minutes from Paris. The confirmed lineup includes Bob Sinclar, Kavinsky, Hannah Laing, Skream & Benga, Petit Biscuit, Ascendant Vierge and more.

events.title: The Neighbourhood
events.summary: The Neighbourhood play Accor Arena on their world tour, with Noise Dept. and Nessa Barrett listed as openers. The venue page confirms the 8 September 2026 date.

events.title: Global Black Pride Music Festival 2026
events.summary: Global Black Pride lists its Music Festival in Paris for 12–13 September 2026, billed as The Global Black Queer Fest. The event page highlights live music, iconic performances, day and after-parties, and sounds including house and amapiano.

events.title: Céline Dion Paris 2026
events.summary: Céline Dion opens her Paris La Défense Arena residency on Saturday 12 September 2026, with the venue FAQ listing further September and October dates. This is a representative confirmed September date for the residency.

events.title: Melanie Martinez — HADES: THE SACRIFICE
events.summary: Melanie Martinez brings the HADES: THE SACRIFICE tour to Accor Arena in support of her fourth studio album, HADES. The Accor Arena page confirms the concert for 15 September 2026.

events.title: The Pussycat Dolls — PCD Forever Tour
events.summary: The Pussycat Dolls return to Accor Arena with Lil’ Kim on the PCD Forever Tour. The venue confirms the Paris concert for 19 September 2026.

events.title: Carbonne
events.summary: French rap/hip-hop artist Carbonne plays L’Olympia after a prior run including sold-out La Cigale shows. The Olympia page confirms the concert for Saturday 12 September 2026 at 20:00.

events.title: Nightclubbing Festival
events.venueName: La Villette and multiple Paris venues
events.summary: Jen Cardini and AEG Presents France launch Nightclubbing Festival from 24–27 September 2026, based at La Villette and spread across Paris clubs and cultural venues. The concept celebrates electronic music, nightlife culture, and the collective energy of the dancefloor.

events.title: A$AP Rocky — Don’t Be Dumb World Tour
events.summary: A$AP Rocky brings the Don’t Be Dumb World Tour to Accor Arena for a Paris arena date. The venue page confirms the concert for 30 September 2026.

events.title: Loreen — The Wildfire Tour
events.summary: Loreen plays Salle Pleyel on The Wildfire Tour, with the venue listing a 30 September 2026 concert at 20:00. The show supports her 2026 Wildfire album era.

data.notes: October 2026 is already anchored by major arena pop/rap dates, electronic standouts, and two confirmed multi-day industry/festival events.

events.title: Céline Dion Paris 2026 – October residency dates
events.summary: Céline Dion’s Paris residency continues through October with confirmed dates on October 2, 3, 7, 9, 10, 14, 16 and 17 at Paris La Défense Arena. The run is billed as sixteen Paris dates from September 12 to October 17, 2026.

events.title: Dream Nation Festival 2026
events.venueName: Parc des Expositions Paris Nord Villepinte
events.summary: Dream Nation returns for two Halloween-themed electronic nights at Paris Nord Villepinte. The first wave includes Pendulum, Vini Vici, The Bloody Beetroots, Flux Pavilion, Da Tweekaz, Novah, Alignment and more across techno, bass, trance and hard music stages.

events.title: MaMA Music & Convention 2026
events.summary: MaMA returns from Wednesday October 14 to Friday October 16, 2026, combining a music-industry convention with public concerts across Pigalle and Montmartre. The official 2026 artist lineup has not yet been published.

events.title: The Strokes
events.summary: The Strokes play a landmark Paris arena show at Accor Arena on October 22, 2026. The venue page confirms the band will perform around the release of their upcoming seventh album, Reality Awaits, alongside catalog material.

events.title: Jungle
events.summary: British trio Jungle play Accor Arena on October 30, 2026, billed by the venue as their biggest French show to date. The date supports their 2026 album Sunshine.

events.title: Bigflo & Oli
events.summary: French rap duo Bigflo & Oli bring their Karma tour to Accor Arena for two confirmed nights on October 19 and 20, 2026. The venue lists both concerts at 20:00.

events.title: Autechre
events.summary: Autechre perform at Le Bataclan on October 14, 2026. The Bataclan listing frames the date as part of Sean Booth and Rob Brown’s European shows in September and October 2026.

events.title: Gradur
events.summary: French trap artist Gradur plays his first Accor Arena show on October 16, 2026. The venue bills it as a landmark night in French rap history.

events.title: Meryl
events.summary: Meryl is confirmed for two Accor Arena concerts on October 26 and 27, 2026. The venue describes the run as her first show at the arena and highlights her cross-style vocal approach.

events.title: Mosimann Live
events.summary: Mosimann brings his live electronic show to Zénith Paris - La Villette on October 17 and 18, 2026. The venue positions the show as a stage-designed live performance tied to his 2026 creative cycle.

events.title: Alizée
events.summary: Alizée plays Zénith Paris - La Villette on October 4, 2026, as part of her 25th-anniversary return to the stage. The official venue page confirms the single Paris date.

events.title: Lake Street Dive
events.summary: Lake Street Dive perform at Le Bataclan on October 16, 2026. The venue describes the show around their album Good Together, mixing soul, pop, groove and jazz influences.

data.notes: January 2026 was heavy on pre-Carnival soca, calypso and steelpan programming around Port of Spain, with major fetes clustering on the final weekend of the month.

events.title: French Toast "The Breakfast & Bacchanal Fete"
events.summary: House of Siete billed French Toast as the official breakfast fete to start Trinidad Carnival 2026. The event was confirmed for Queen Hall, St Ann on Sunday, January 4, 2026.

events.title: Mical Teja | MAS The Experience '26
events.summary: Mical Teja presented MAS The Experience as a Carnival culture-and-music event at Queen's Hall Gardens. The ticket page listed it for January 11–12, 2026 from 5:00 PM to midnight.

events.title: NEON - The Lit Fete
events.summary: WinerBoy Entertainment's NEON - The Lit Fete was listed as a music and Carnival event at Queen's Park Oval. TicketGateway confirmed the date as January 16–17, 2026, 9:00 PM–3:00 AM.

events.title: Phoenix The Festival
events.summary: Holy Name Convent's Phoenix The Festival returned as a food-inclusive cooler experience with a soca-artiste lineup. The event page confirmed January 17, 2026 at 2 Queen's Park East, Port of Spain.

events.title: National Junior Panorama Finals 2026
events.summary: Pan Trinbago confirmed the National Junior Panorama Finals for January 18, 2026 at Queen's Park Savannah. The steelpan finals featured 21 & Under and 19 & Under categories.

events.title: D'Kaiso Dynasty
events.summary: D'Kaiso Dynasty was a TUCO calypso-tent night at the Radisson Hotel on Wrightson Road. The January 31 listing named a large cast including Brother Valentino, Gypsy, Karene Asche, Yung Bredda, Rikki Jai, Preedy and others.

events.title: Soaka Arts + Music Fest Weekend
events.summary: Soaka Arts + Music Fest Weekend bundled three official events from January 23–25, 2026: Iron Park, wOw Carnival Market and Soaka Till Sunrise. The festival focused on Carnival music, steelpan culture, DJs, paint, powder and soca energy.

events.title: Soca Village - For the Love of Soca Music
events.summary: House of Siete's Soca Village was positioned as a throwback soca fete focused on soca from the 1980s through the present. Island E-Tickets confirmed it for January 24–25, 2026 at Rock Back, Chaguaramas.

events.title: QRC Fete: Ramajay
events.summary: QRC Events confirmed Fete Royal: Ramajay as a Carnival 2026 fete at Queen's Royal College Grounds. The event was scheduled for January 31–February 1, 2026 from 6:30 PM to 2:00 AM.

events.title: Fete Gala
events.summary: Fete Gala was listed as an all-inclusive Carnival experience at Queen's Park Oval. Soca News confirmed the event for January 31–February 1, 2026 from 6:00 PM to 2:00 AM.

events.title: SOTU presents Enamour
events.summary: SOTU presented Enamour at Club Vice on Cipriani Boulevard. The listing described Enamour's sound as deep house, progressive and dark techno, with the event running January 31–February 1, 2026.

data.notes: February 2026 in Port of Spain was dominated by Trinidad Carnival week, with the strongest verified music programming centered on steelpan, calypso, mas and soca fetes around Queen’s Park Savannah and nearby venues.

events.title: National Panorama 2026 Medium & Large Conventional Band Semi-Finals: Savannah Party
events.summary: Pan Trinbago’s Savannah Party presented the Medium and Large Conventional Band Semi-Finals for National Panorama 2026, with Grand Stand viewing and North Stand party options at Queen’s Park Savannah.

events.title: National Panorama 2026 Medium Conventional Band Finals
events.summary: The rescheduled National Panorama Medium Conventional Band Finals took place at Queen’s Park Savannah with free public admission and featured the country’s leading medium steel orchestras.

events.title: Monday Madness 2026: Soca Insanity
events.summary: Machel Montano’s tour listing confirms Monday Madness 2026 at Queen’s Park Oval; the Carnival-week concert/fete was billed as Soca Insanity and featured Machel with The Monk Band.

events.title: KES IZWE Festival 2026: Roots & Riddim
events.summary: KES’s IZWE Festival returned to Queen’s Park Savannah under the Roots & Riddim banner, presenting a Carnival festival experience built around live music, food, art and culture.

events.title: LIME 2026: The Ultimate Carnival Fete
events.summary: LIME 2026 was the Hyatt Regency Trinidad’s ultra all-inclusive Carnival Wednesday fete, with a 2026 entertainment bill including Kes The Band, Ravi B & Karma, Farmer Nappy, Destra, Mical Teja, Machel Montano and others.

events.title: Punchy Wednesday 2026: The Championship
events.summary: Punchy Wednesday 2026 was a Carnival Wednesday all-inclusive cooler fete and DJ/band performance event at Queen’s Park Oval, listed by TriniJungleJuice from 9 PM to 4 AM.

events.title: TRIBE Ignite: Carnival Thursday
events.summary: TRIBE Ignite was a Carnival Thursday drinks-inclusive fete at the Hasely Crawford Stadium Training Field, with the event page highlighting Kes The Band as part of the entertainment lineup.

events.title: National Panorama 2026 Large Conventional Band Finals
events.summary: Pan Trinbago’s Large Conventional Band Finals brought eleven major steel orchestras to Queen’s Park Savannah for the flagship National Panorama final on Carnival Saturday.

events.title: Dimanche Gras 2026
events.summary: Dimanche Gras 2026 was staged at Carnival City, Queen’s Park Savannah from Sunday night into Monday morning, combining pageantry, music, calypso and Carnival royalty presentations before Carnival Monday.

events.title: J’ouvert Morning 2026 with Dirty Dozen J’ouvert
events.summary: Dirty Dozen J’ouvert’s 2026 all-inclusive J’ouvert experience took place in Port of Spain on Carnival Monday morning, including the DDJ pre-party, road experience and signature after-party.

events.title: Senior Parade of the Bands 2026
events.summary: Presented by the Trinidad and Tobago Carnival Bands Association, the Senior Parade of the Bands was the two-day centrepiece of Trinidad Carnival 2026, with masquerade bands crossing at Carnival City, Queen’s Park Savannah.

events.title: Carnival Lagniappe 2026
events.summary: Carnival Lagniappe 2026 was billed by Pan Trinbago as a post-Carnival grand finale featuring champions of Carnival across steelpan, mas, calypso, soca and related traditions.

data.notes: June is anchored by Reykjavík Arts Festival’s contemporary and classical program, with Harpa adding headline pop concerts later in the month.

events.title: Close-up – Hildur Guðnadóttir & Iceland Symphony Orchestra
events.summary: The Iceland Symphony Orchestra presents an evening with composer Hildur Guðnadóttir, featuring her music from films including Joker, Tár and A Haunting in Venice alongside works by key influences.

events.title: Fischersund: A Night of Scent & Music
events.summary: Fischersund brings its scented-concert concept to Reykjavík with Jónsi, Sin Fang and Kjartan Holm performing compositions tied to the house’s fragrances, with video works by Ingibjörg Birgisdóttir.

events.title: Hildur Guðnadóttir – Where to From
events.summary: Hildur Guðnadóttir performs Where to From for the first time in Iceland at Harpa’s Silfurberg, alongside earlier works and an ensemble including Liam Byrne, Peyee Chen, Nina Guo, Sarah Saviet and Clare O’Connell.

events.title: viibra: Venutian Wetland
events.summary: The flute septet viibra performs Venutian Wetland, a new sound-and-movement work by Bergrún Snæbjörnsdóttir and choreographer Margrét Bjarnadóttir, as part of Reykjavík Arts Festival.

events.title: LOVE LOVE
events.summary: LOVE LOVE is a Reykjavík Arts Festival premiere by Arnbjörg María Danielsen, created with Leah Marojević, Ensemble Adapter and electronic musician Salka Valsdóttir, blending sound, movement, bodies, objects and electronics.

events.title: Niður – an Icelandic Circus on Ljósagangur
events.summary: Skerpla – Experimental Sound Lab presents an Icelandic version of John Cage’s Roaratorio concept, transforming Dagur Hjartarson’s novel Ljósagangur into an installation and live musical performance.

events.title: John Grant
events.summary: Reykjavík Arts Festival presents John Grant at Harpa’s Eldborg, billed as his first major concert in Iceland in many years.

events.title: Reykjavík Arts Festival Closing Party
events.summary: The festival hub closes with DJ Choconilla and dj Lui playing African-inspired selections including amapiano, afrobeat and pop, followed by DJ 101 Savage with live visuals.

events.title: Reykjavík Arts Festival: Angel Blue
events.summary: American soprano Angel Blue performs with pianist Bryan Wagorn on the closing day of Reykjavík Arts Festival, with a program spanning Fauré, Debussy, Strauss, Gershwin and African American spirituals.

events.title: 10cc
events.summary: 10cc, led by founding member Graham Gouldman with the current touring band, performs at Harpa’s Eldborg with a set built around the group’s classic pop catalogue.

events.title: Katie Melua
events.summary: Katie Melua performs at Harpa’s Eldborg with her group, in a concert advertised as featuring her best-known songs.

events.title: Stefán Hilmarsson – 26.06.26
events.summary: Icelandic singer Stefán Hilmarsson marks a major birthday and a forty-year career milestone with two Eldborg concerts featuring a full band, brass section and special guests.

data.notes: Confirmed July listings are still relatively sparse, with Harpa/Hallgrímskirkja summer programming and David Byrne’s arena show standing out among announced dates.

events.title: Midday Music in Harpa
events.summary: Harpa’s July daytime concert series runs from July 2–31 in Eldborg, with Icelandic musicians performing acoustic songs on the Eldborg stage. The source explicitly lists multiple 11:00 and 12:00 performances across the month.

events.title: With Four Hands & Four Feet — Opening Concert of the Organ Summer
events.summary: Hallgrímskirkja organists Björn Steinar Sólbergsson and Steinar Logi Helgason open the Organ Summer series by performing on both the Klais concert organ and Frobenius choir organ. The program includes works by Gigout, Pachelbel, J. B. Bach, Jón Nordal, Ravel and Þorkell Sigurbjörnsson.

events.title: JóiPé X Króli
events.summary: Icelandic duo JóiPé and Króli perform with their band at Háskólabíó on July 24. The Tix listing confirms the 20:00 show in Háskólabíó - Salur 1.

events.title: David Byrne — Who Is The Sky? Tour
events.summary: David Byrne brings the Who Is The Sky? Tour to Laugardalshöll with Ghost Train Orchestra on July 29. The Tix event page confirms the Reykjavík concert date and 20:00 start time.

data.notes: August 2026 in Reykjavík is unusually strong around the solar eclipse, with Björk’s Echolalia, Árstíðir’s eclipse concert, and Reykjavík Jazz anchoring the month.

events.title: LATIN NIGHT IN ICELAND!
events.summary: A Latin dance night at Sykursalurinn with DJ Gato Beat from Venezuela and DJ Juanjo Vivanco from Spain, running from salsa, bachata and merengue into late-night perreo.

events.title: Reykjavík International Piano Festival
events.summary: The inaugural Reykjavík International Piano Festival runs August 3–12 with masterclasses, workshops and public performance opportunities at Harpa Concert Hall.

events.title: Árstíðir – Sólmyrkvi
events.summary: Árstíðir perform a special eclipse-themed concert in central Reykjavík on the night before the total solar eclipse, with a contemplative programme drawing on Icelandic traditions.

events.title: Echolalia – Eclipse x Exhibition Festival
events.summary: Björk hosts a one-day solar-eclipse festival very near Reykjavík with DJ sets by Björk and Arca plus Ronja and Sideproject, tied to Björk’s National Gallery exhibition and Smekkleysa’s 40th birthday.

events.title: Salsaball með Barrio 27
events.summary: Barrio 27, a 16-piece salsa band, hosts its first full salsa dance night at the former NASA venue, beginning with a beginner lesson before the live set.

events.title: Culture Night / Menningarnótt
events.summary: Reykjavík’s largest city festival is confirmed for August 22, with city-centre cultural programming that traditionally includes concerts, choirs, DJs, street performances and fireworks.

events.title: Aurelio Voltaire á Iðnó
events.summary: Aurelio Voltaire returns to Iceland for a third time, performing his songs at IÐNÓ after more than 30 years of touring as a musician and multidisciplinary artist.

events.title: Reykjavík Jazz Festival
events.summary: Reykjavík Jazz Festival runs August 25–30 across venues including Harpa, Fantasía, Austurbær and Iðnó, with confirmed artists including Ingi Bjarni Quartet, Kosmonauci, Tom Sochas Trio, Matti Klein Soul Trio, LILJA and Anna Gréta.

events.title: Stórtónleikar Ásgeirs Trausta í Eldborg
events.summary: Ásgeir plays a major Eldborg concert celebrating his album Julia, with songs from across his Icelandic and English-language catalogue plus new material from an upcoming Icelandic-language album.

data.notes: September 2026 is anchored by experimental/electronic festival Extreme Chill, the Vaka folk gathering, and several large Icelandic pop/hip-hop anniversary shows.

events.title: Extreme Chill Festival 2026
events.summary: Extreme Chill returns to Reykjavík for its 17th year, focusing on experimental, electronic and ambient music across four days in the city center.

events.title: Mania: The ABBA Tribute
